title: The deep forest west of Camp Gallows (Thornwold) strings together many visually similar unnamed-feeling 'wood' rooms with no bearings/map aid inside it, so finding the route to 'the gallows glade' meant trial-and-error room-hopping rather than following any signpost, unlike the Vale's watchtower parapet 'get your bearings' option.
